story.iWant: to implement the core UI design system based on Tailwind CSS and our UX principles
story.soThat: all user-facing components have a consistent, clean, and friendly aesthetic
story.tasks: - [ ] **Implement Core UI Components (AC: 1)** - [ ] Configure Tailwind CSS for "Guided Minimalism" principles (e.g., spacing, typography). - [ ] Integrate shadcn/ui components into the project. - [ ] Create initial styled button components. - [ ] Create initial styled form input and label components. - [ ] Define and implement basic application layout components (e.g., header, sidebar, main content area). - [ ] Establish a clear directory structure for reusable UI components. - [ ] **Apply "Calm & Focused" Color Palette (AC: 2)** - [ ] Define custom color variables within the Tailwind CSS configuration (`tailwind.config.cjs`). - [ ] Apply the defined color palette to all core UI components implemented. - [ ] **Theme shadcn/ui Components (AC: 3)** - [ ] Customize selected shadcn/ui components (e.g., Dialog, Card, Tabs, Input) to align with the "Calm & Focused" design specification. - [ ] **Testing & Quality Assurance** - [ ] Conduct manual UI review to ensure adherence to "Guided Minimalism" principles (whitespace, focus, CTAs). - [ ] Implement unit tests (Jest/React Testing Library) for core UI components to verify rendering and basic interaction. - [ ] Implement visual regression tests for critical UI components to ensure consistent styling and theming. - [ ] Perform manual UI review to verify consistent application of the "Calm & Focused" color palette. - [ ] Perform manual UI review of all themed shadcn/ui components against the design specification.

criterion.description: **Given** the Next.js application is set up with shadcn/ui **When** core UI components (e.g., buttons, forms, layout) are implemented **Then** they adhere to the principles of "Guided Minimalism" (abundant white space, single-column focus, clear CTAs).
**And** they are styled consistently using the "Calm & Focused" color palette.
**And** shadcn/ui components are themed to match the design specification.

doc.title: ibe160 - Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: The AI Study Buddy's user experience should embody a supportive, easy/simple, and playful feel. The overall aesthetic will be academic, friendly, and clean, designed to reduce cognitive load and foster a sense of calm and control.

doc.title: ibe160 - Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR5.1 - Clean & Intuitive UI: The system shall provide a simple, clean, and intuitive user interface that supports step-by-step guidance. FR5.2 - Web Application Responsiveness: The system shall be a Single Page Application (SPA) that is mobile-responsive and functions across target browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari). FR5.3 - Core Accessibility Features: The system shall incorporate core accessibility features, including WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance, strong screen-reader support, and reduced-motion options.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: UI, UX, & Accessibility Polish
doc.snippet: This epic focuses on refining the user interface and overall user experience to ensure the AI Study Buddy is intuitive, accessible, and enjoyable. In-Scope: Implement a clean, intuitive, and responsive UI... Utilize Shadcn/ui for component library, customized to the "Calm & Focused" color theme and "Guided Minimalism" design direction.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: UI, UX, & Accessibility Polish
doc.snippet: This epic primarily involves the development and enhancement of frontend UI modules and components, such as Document Preview Component, Drag-and-Drop Upload Area, Loading Screen/Modal for Generation, Quiz Interface, and Summary View.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: UI, UX, & Accessibility Polish
doc.snippet: UI Responsiveness: All UI interactions... must feel instantaneous (<200ms response time). Page Load Times: The Next.js frontend... optimized for fast page loads...

doc.title: AI Study Buddy - High-Level Architecture
doc.snippet: Next.js Frontend: The frontend is a single-page application built with React and Next.js, styled with Tailwind CSS.

doc.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: We will be using shadcn/ui as our design system. This choice aligns perfectly with the project's use of React and Tailwind CSS, offering high customizability and full ownership of component code.

doc.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: The chosen color theme is "Calm & Focused (Revised)"... to create a supportive, calm, and focused learning environment.

doc.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: The chosen design approach is a combination of "Minimalist & Focused" and "Guided Workflow & Progressive," which we can call "Guided Minimalism" or "Focused Workflow."

doc.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Our responsive design strategy will prioritize a mobile-first approach... leverage Tailwind CSS's utility-first framework for efficient breakpoint management.

doc.title: ibe160 UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Accessibility is a core principle... We will adhere to WCAG 2.1 AA standards. Semantic HTML, Keyboard Navigation, ARIA Attributes, Color Contrast, Alternative Text, Form Accessibility, Focus Management, Testing.

constraint.description: All UI components must be styled using Tailwind CSS, adhering to its utility-first principles.
The UI will leverage shadcn/ui components, customized and themed to match the project's design specification.
Components must adhere to "Guided Minimalism" principles, including abundant white space, single-column focus where appropriate, and clear Calls to Action (CTAs).
All visual elements must use the "Calm & Focused" color palette, as defined in the UX Design Specification.
Components must be designed with a mobile-first approach, ensuring graceful adaptation across various screen sizes using Tailwind CSS responsive utilities.
New UI components must incorporate core accessibility features and strive for WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance, including semantic HTML, keyboard navigability, and appropriate ARIA attributes.

tests.standards: Testing for this story will primarily involve Jest and React Testing Library for unit testing UI components. Visual regression testing will be considered for critical components. Manual UI/UX and accessibility reviews are essential to ensure adherence to design principles and accessibility standards. Cross-browser and device testing will validate responsiveness.

ideas.idea: Verify core UI components (buttons, forms, layout) render correctly and adhere to "Guided Minimalism" principles (e.g., whitespace, CTAs).
Confirm core UI components are styled consistently using the "Calm & Focused" color palette across various states (hover, active, disabled).
Ensure themed shadcn/ui components (e.g., Dialog, Card, Input) visually match the design specification.
Perform manual review to check keyboard navigability and screen reader announcements for core components.
Conduct visual regression tests on key UI components to detect unintentional style changes.
